newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia OTC weekly trade weaker, index up 0.08 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatia OTC weekly trade weaker, index up 0.08 pct.

text.p: Croatian over-the counter stocks trade weakened but the VIN index regained 0.08 percent on a weekly basis to July 25, the Varazdin OTC market said on Monday.

The leading seven-stock index climbed to 9,760 from 9,752 points as 14 active issues rose, four lost ground and five closed the week unchanged. Dubrovacka Banka made a debut, trading 100 shares at 7,000 kuna each.
Volume shrank to 19,801 from 87,314 units, with turnover falling to 7.5 from 13.2 million kuna.
The most actively traded issue was electronics firm Ericsson Tesla with 10,019 shares sold. It added 1.09 percent to end at 460 kuna.
Split's shipyard Brodospas led gainers, rising 15.7 percent to 110 kuna on volume of 72 shares.
Losers' list was topped by shipper Jadroagent, which lost 16.6 percent to 150 kuna with 19 units sold.
